title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
abstract: arXiv:2610.28988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents. Attention Tracker (Hung et al., 2025) is a recently proposed white-box detection method that identifies prompt injection attacks by monitoring how a model's attention is distributed between user task tokens and data tokens, claiming dataset-agnostic detection via a scalar focus score threshold. In this paper, we provide the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark, finding that the dataset agnosticism claim does not hold. We find that in agentic environments, long structured tool outputs subvert the fundamental assumptions Attention Tracker makes about attention that the method depends on and produces near-chance detection on AgentDojo across most model families. translated_title: 基于注意力机制的间接提示注入分类方法
translated_abstract: 间接提示注入（IPI）攻击是指对抗性指令被嵌入到语言模型所处理的外部数据中，这对已部署的LLM智能体的完整性构成重大威胁。Attention Tracker（Hung et al., 2025）是最近提出的一种白盒检测方法，它通过监控模型注意力在用户任务标记和数据标记之间的分布来识别提示注入攻击，并声称通过一个标量焦点分数阈值即可实现与数据集无关的检测。在本文中，我们首次在使用AgentDojo基准的真实智能体IPI场景下对Attention Tracker进行了评估，发现其数据集无关性的声明并不成立。我们发现，在智能体环境中，长篇结构化的工具输出颠覆了Attention Tracker方法所依赖的关于注意力的基本假设，导致该方法在AgentDojo上对大多数模型家族的检测效果接近随机猜测。我们提出Att…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次在真实的智能体场景（AgentDojo基准）下评估了Attention Tracker检测方法，发现其声称的数据集无关性并不成立——长结构化工具输出会颠覆其注意力假设并使检测效果接近随机，进而提出了基于注意力分类的改进检测方案。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using AgentDojo, showing that its dataset-agnostic claim fails as long structured tool outputs subvert its attention assumptions and yield near-chance detection, and proposes an attention-based classification approach instead.
